integrity: The proof independently reconstructs the directional area inequality, identifies all equality conditions almost everywhere in angle, uses convexity of the quadratic remainder to propagate shell equality back to the minimizer, and proves the converse directly. No finite experiment or numerical evidence is used.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to dimension two, C2 regularity, and the interior-critical-point case. It classifies exact equality for a positive-thickness shell but makes no claim about higher-dimensional equality or the hyperbolic level-set estimates.
title: Finite-shell equality rigidity for the planar strongly convex level-set bound
